name: feature
description: A change to a service, from plan to acceptance on staging

stages.goal: Read the ticket and the code, and write what you learn in the notes
Write plan.md with an approach, the repositories and numbered acceptance scenarios, then submit it
Bind the repositories, change the code, commit, and run the tests at the commit
Review the change before anyone else sees it
Push, open the pull request, and wait for its checks
Run each acceptance scenario on staging and record its result with evidence
